swsh12.5gg-GG01.name: Hisuian Voltorb
swsh12.5gg-GG01.description: An enigmatic Pokémon that happens to bear a resemblance to a Poké Ball. When excited, it discharges the electric current it has stored in its belly, then lets out a great, uproarious laugh.

attacks.name: Cheerful Charge
attacks.effect: You can use this attack only if you go second, and only during your first turn. Choose up to 2 of your Benched Pokémon. For each of those Pokémon, search your deck for a basic Energy card and attach it to that Pokémon. Then, shuffle your deck.

swsh12.5gg-GG02.name: Kricketune
swsh12.5gg-GG02.description: It signals its emotions with its melodies. Scientists are studying these melodic patterns.

abilities.name: Swelling Tune
abilities.effect: Your Grass Pokémon in play, except any Kricketune, get +40 HP. You can't apply more than 1 Swelling Tune Ability at a time.

swsh12.5gg-GG03.name: Magmortar
swsh12.5gg-GG03.description: When Magmortar inhales deeply, the fire burning in its belly intensifies, rising in temperature to over 3,600 degrees Fahrenheit.

attacks.name: Boltsplosion

swsh12.5gg-GG04.name: Oricorio
swsh12.5gg-GG04.description: This Oricorio has drunk red nectar. If its Trainer gives the wrong order, this passionate Pokémon becomes fiercely angry.

abilities.name: Lesson in Zeal
abilities.effect: All of your Fusion Strike Pokémon take 20 less damage from attacks from your opponent's Pokémon (after applying Weakness and Resistance). You can't apply more than 1 Lesson in Zeal Ability at a time.

attacks.name: Glistening Droplets
attacks.effect: Put 5 damage counters on your opponent's Pokémon in any way you like.

swsh12.5gg-GG05.name: Lapras
swsh12.5gg-GG05.description: A smart and kindhearted Pokémon, it glides across the surface of the sea while its beautiful song echoes around it.

attacks.name: Raging Freeze
attacks.effect: If any of your Pokémon were Knocked Out by damage from an attack from your opponent's Pokémon during their last turn, your opponent's Active Pokémon is now Paralyzed.

swsh12.5gg-GG06.name: Manaphy
swsh12.5gg-GG06.description: It starts its life with a wondrous power that permits it to bond with any kind of Pokémon.

abilities.name: Wave Veil
abilities.effect: Prevent all damage done to your Benched Pokémon by attacks from your opponent's Pokémon.

swsh12.5gg-GG07.name: Keldeo
swsh12.5gg-GG07.description: When it is resolute, its body fills with power and it becomes swifter. Its jumps are then too fast to follow.

attacks.name: Line Force

swsh12.5gg-GG08.name: Electivire
swsh12.5gg-GG08.description: The amount of electrical energy this Pokémon produces is proportional to the rate of its pulse. The voltage jumps while Electivire is battling.

attacks.name: Explosive Bolt

attacks.name: High-Voltage Current

swsh12.5gg-GG09.name: Toxtricity
swsh12.5gg-GG09.description: It has an electrical organ on its chest. While generating electricity, it fills its surroundings with what sounds like the strumming of a bass guitar.

abilities.name: Maximum Downer

swsh12.5gg-GG10.name: Mew
swsh12.5gg-GG10.description: Its DNA is said to contain the genetic codes of all Pokémon, so it can use all kinds of techniques.

abilities.name: Mysterious Tail

swsh12.5gg-GG11.name: Lunatone
swsh12.5gg-GG11.description: The phase of the moon apparently has some effect on its power. It's active on the night of a full moon.

attacks.name: Cycle Draw
attacks.effect: Discard a card from your hand. If you do, draw 3 cards.

attacks.name: Moon Kinesis
attacks.effect: This attack does 30 more damage for each Psychic Energy attached to this Pokémon.

swsh12.5gg-GG12.name: Deoxys
swsh12.5gg-GG12.description: DNA from a space virus mutated and became a Pokémon. It appears where auroras are seen.

attacks.name: Photon Boost

swsh12.5gg-GG13.name: Diancie
swsh12.5gg-GG13.description: It can instantly create many diamonds by compressing the carbon in the air between its hands.

abilities.name: Princess's Curtain
abilities.effect: As long as this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, whenever your opponent plays a Supporter card from their hand, prevent all effects of that card done to your Benched Basic Pokémon.

attacks.name: Spike Draw

swsh12.5gg-GG14.name: Comfey
swsh12.5gg-GG14.description: Comfey picks flowers with its vine and decorates itself with them. For some reason, flowers won't wither once they're attached to a Comfey.

abilities.name: Flower Selecting
abilities.effect: Once during your turn, if this Pokémon is in the Active Spot, you may look at the top 2 cards of your deck and put 1 of them into your hand. Put the other card in the Lost Zone.

swsh12.5gg-GG15.name: Solrock
swsh12.5gg-GG15.description: When it rotates itself, it gives off light similar to the sun, thus blinding its foes.

swsh12.5gg-GG16.name: Absol
swsh12.5gg-GG16.description: Swift as the wind, Absol races through fields and mountains. Its curved, bow-like horn is acutely sensitive to the warning signs of natural disasters.

swsh12.5gg-GG17.name: Thievul
swsh12.5gg-GG17.description: It secretly marks potential targets with a scent. By following the scent, it stalks its targets and steals from them when they least expect it.

swsh12.5gg-GG18.name: Magnezone
swsh12.5gg-GG18.description: Some say that Magnezone receives signals from space via the antenna on its head and that it's being controlled by some mysterious being.

abilities.name: Giga Magnet

swsh12.5gg-GG19.name: Altaria
swsh12.5gg-GG19.description: On sunny days, it flies freely through the sky and blends into the clouds. It sings in a beautiful soprano.

abilities.name: Tempting Tune

swsh12.5gg-GG20.name: Latias

attacks.name: Dyna Barrier

swsh12.5gg-GG21.name: Hisuian Goodra
swsh12.5gg-GG21.description: Able to freely control the hardness of its metallic shell. It loathes solitude and is extremely clingy— it will fume and run riot if those dearest to it ever leave its side.

swsh12.5gg-GG22.name: Ditto
swsh12.5gg-GG22.description: It can reconstitute its entire cellular structure to change into what it sees, but it returns to normal when it relaxes.

swsh12.5gg-GG23.name: Dunsparce
swsh12.5gg-GG23.description: When it sees a person, it digs a hole with its tail to make its escape. If you happen to find one, consider yourself lucky.

swsh12.5gg-GG24.name: Miltank
swsh12.5gg-GG24.description: Miltank produces highly nutritious milk, so it's been supporting the lives of people and other Pokémon since ancient times.

swsh12.5gg-GG25.name: Bibarel

swsh12.5gg-GG26.name: Riolu

swsh12.5gg-GG27.name: Swablu
swsh12.5gg-GG27.description: It constantly grooms its cotton-like wings. It takes a shower to clean itself if it becomes dirty.

swsh12.5gg-GG29.name: Bidoof

swsh12.5gg-GG31.name: Turtwig

swsh12.5gg-GG32.name: Paras
swsh12.5gg-GG32.description: The mushrooms, known as tochukaso, are controlling the bug. Even if the bug bugs the mushrooms, they tell it to bug off.
